title: Nature Under Threat
instruction: Restore a habitat network across three zones while Lantana, a dry spell and monsoon run-off strike.
intro: Several zones are under pressure at once. The nearest damaged cell is rarely the most valuable one — look for the intervention with the biggest overall benefit.

events.title: Lantana in the east
events.text: Lantana threatens the forest beside the nest tree.

events.title: Monsoon run-off
events.text: Heavy rain: marked streamside cells that are still degraded at round end wash out to bare ground.

events.title: Dry spell
events.text: Hot winds before the rain: 1 less capacity and no natural regrowth this round.

events.title: Lantana in the west
events.text: Lantana spreads into the West Woodland.

objectives.label: Squirrel route across all three zones
Hornbill nest with a live fig
Frog breeding forest at the river

challenge.text: Keep the West Woodland fig healthy.
